style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 3 Bayana Woven Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: This Bayana woven baubles combine two distinct materials in a simple yet striking design. A clear, glass bubble forms the base, enclosed in a handwoven lattice of natural rattan. The contrast between smooth glass along with textured fibre offers a natural warmth and tactile quality to the piece. Whether hung on a Christmas tree or used as decorative accents around the home, they offer a clean, considered take on festive styling. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade. Dimensions(mm): Height: 80. Width: 70. Depth: 70.
